summary.en: Part-time internship at Georgia's leading anti-corruption watchdog, with places in Tbilisi and regional offices (Batumi, Kutaisi, Zugdidi, Telavi). Interns support research, monitoring and advocacy on transparency and accountability.

about.en:
Transparency International Georgia runs an office internship programme for students interested in transparency, accountability and anti-corruption work. Interns are placed in the Tbilisi office or in regional offices.

The internship is part-time and is described as volunteer; it is not a paid role. Applicants write by email and put the city in the subject line, for example 'Internship - Tbilisi'.

Strong fit for law, political science, public administration and journalism students who want NGO and policy experience. Check the official page for current tasks and requirements.

en: Anti-corruption NGO with offices in several Georgian cities
ar: منظمة لمكافحة الفساد بمكاتب في عدة مدن

eligibility.en: University students interested in transparency, accountability and anti-corruption. Georgian language expected; open to students based in Georgia (no work permit route is described).

en: Prepare a CV and short motivation letter
Email it with the subject 'Internship - ' plus your city (Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi, Zugdidi or Telavi)

score_reason: Reachable and real, but unpaid and undated page.
